title: Revolut Partners with OpenAI to Offer ChatGPT Go
description: Revolut, a digital banking platform, has partnered with OpenAI to provide ChatGPT Go to its customers.

sections.heading: Partnership Announcement
paragraphs: Revolut has announced a partnership with OpenAI to bring ChatGPT Go to millions of customers, according to Revolut.

sections.heading: Subscription Offer
paragraphs: Notebookcheck reports that with a new Revolut account, customers can get a ChatGPT subscription free for up to a year.

sections.heading: AI Provider Expansion
paragraphs: Trending Topics notes that ChatGPT Go is the third AI provider added to Revolut's subscription bundle.

faq.q: What is being offered to Revolut customers?
faq.a: ChatGPT Go is being offered to Revolut customers.

faq.q: Is there a subscription offer available?
faq.a: Yes, a ChatGPT subscription free for up to a year is available with a new Revolut account.

faq.q: How many AI providers does Revolut now have in its subscription bundle?
faq.a: Revolut now has three AI providers in its subscription bundle.
